metadata.summary: Jutin ordered a Breakfast Bundle from Manhattan Bagel

messages.text: Hello Jutin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
Can can I get breakfast bundle?

The Breakfast Bundle is a great choice. It includes 13 fresh-baked Manhattan Bagels and 2 tubs of cream cheese. You'll need to pick 13 bagels for your bundle. We have Plain, Everything, Sesame, and Cinnamon Raisin. How many of each would you like, or should I list more options?
